title: Tenses and Verb Patterns — Level 8 — Arrange and transform

items.prompt: Arrange the words: already / the / has / Sinta / finished / report

items.prompt: Arrange the words: going / we / to / are / camp / near / the / beach

items.prompt: Rewrite in the present perfect continuous: "It started raining at noon. It is still raining now."

items.reteach: Mulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung: has been + V-ing; titik awal memakai since.
